items.summary: In its interim report for 1 January to 30 September 2026, published on 19 November 2026, H100 Group says fully diluted bitcoin per share rose from 288.49 to 301.06 sats, an increase of 4.36%. The company's bitcoin holdings went from 1,051.03 BTC at the start of the quarter to 3,476.80 BTC at the end, after the acquisition of NSD, which took the holding to 3,506.4 BTC at completion, and a loss of about 30 BTC in an active pool of 233.42 BTC. Profit before tax was 142.9 million kronor, including a one-off gain of 171.0 million kronor from the acquisition; without that gain the result would have been negative. The report has not been reviewed by the company's auditors. The board has called an extraordinary general meeting for 7 December 2026 to seek authorisation to buy back shares; the company has not decided on a buyback, and that meeting has not yet been held.

items.summary: Huddlestock Fintech AS has signed a letter of intent with the crypto exchange Firi for a tied-agent solution using Huddlestock's regulatory infrastructure, according to a stock-exchange notice published on 18 November 2026. The notice describes the arrangement as a letter of intent, not a completed agreement, and says the collaboration remains subject to further commercial, operational and regulatory assessment. Firi would, as planned, become a tied agent under Huddlestock's licence; the release describes Firi as the largest crypto exchange in the Nordics, with about 430,000 retail customers in Norway, Sweden and Denmark.

items.summary: NBX has filed an application for a banking licence in Latvia for its wholly owned subsidiary, NBX Digital Asset Bank AS in Riga, according to a stock exchange notice reported by Kaupr on 17 November 2026. The application is for a specialised credit institution under Latvian law; it has been filed, not granted. Latvijas Banka will ask for more information before the application counts as complete, and the European Central Bank grants the licence on Latvijas Banka's recommendation. NBX says the planned digital bank would operate cross-border in Norway, Lithuania, Sweden, Finland, Poland and Germany, and that operations could start at the earliest by the end of 2027, with 2028 more likely.

items.summary: H100 Group AB has entered into a partnership with Coinbase for institutional custody, trading and financing of its bitcoin holdings through Coinbase Prime and Deribit, according to a company notice on 16 November 2026. The company says it holds about 3,506 bitcoin. On its own price basis of USD 64,600 on 15 November 2026, it valued those holdings at about USD 226 million, or SEK 2.3 billion. Hoang says it is too early to know whether customers are permanently moving funds from foreign exchanges.

items.summary: Sweden's Economic Crime Authority has charged Valuno Group's former chief executive and a former finance director with aggravated insider trading, according to Kaupr and Kryptovalutaguiden. According to the prosecutor, the two learned on 3 July 2025 that Finansinspektionen had refused the subsidiary QB Europe a MiCA licence and sold large parts of their shares before the decision was made public on 4 July, after which the share price fell about 33 percent. Valuno says it is assisting the legal process as needed; no one has been convicted. The charged former chief executive is also a former leader of Medborgerlig Samling and denies wrongdoing, according to SvD; the case is Stockholm District Court B 16085-26.

items.summary: The Norwegian crypto exchange NBX has raised at least 34 million Norwegian kroner from the US investor LDA Capital through ten share issues since 2022, according to Kaupr's tally of the company's stock exchange announcements; the latest, closed on 3 November 2026, raised 6.8 million kroner at 0.47 kroner per share. According to NBX's announcements, the money has funded bitcoin purchases and the capital requirements for its e-money licence and its MiCA licence. Under the agreement, NBX decides when to draw on the facility.

items.summary: Goobit has signed an agreement with Kvarn Metals, which will be the counterparty for gold in its Futureproof savings platform, the company told Kaupr. According to Goobit, the gold is backed 1:1 by physical gold, while bitcoin comes from Kvarn Capital under an agreement made in September. Goobit says both asset classes it needs for launch are now in place.
